classification.difficultyReason: Complete the supplied product and cumulative-frequency columns, calculate four statistics and check with the calculator.

inlines.text: From the table, calculate the mode, range, mean, and median.
Check your answer using a calculator.

answer.worked:
Multiply each data value by its frequency:

$$\begin{align*}1\times7&=7\\2\times4&=8\\3\times7&=21\\4\times8&=32\\5\times9&=45\\6\times8&=48\end{align*}$$

Start C.F. at $7$ and add each next frequency:

$$\begin{align*}7+4&=11\\11+7&=18\\18+8&=26\\26+9&=35\\35+8&=43\\\sum f&=7+4+7+8+9+8\\\sum f&=43\\\sum xf&=7+8+21+32+45+48\\\sum xf&=161\end{align*}$$

The last cumulative frequency is $43$. The C.F. total cell stays as a dash.

The greatest frequency is $9$, corresponding to $x=5$. The mode is $5$.

Calculator check: the frequency column has its largest entry, $9$, beside $x=5$.

$$\begin{align*}\sum f&=43\\\sum xf&=161\\\bar{x}&=\frac{\sum xf}{\sum f}\\\bar{x}&=\frac{161}{43}\\\bar{x}&\approx3.74\end{align*}$$

Calculator check: enter the data values in $x$ and their frequencies in Freq in 1-variable statistics. The mean is $3.744186\ldots$, agreeing with $\frac{161}{43}$.

$$\begin{align*}n&=43\\M_p&=\frac{43+1}{2}\\M_p&=22\end{align*}$$

Cumulative frequency is $18$ through $x=3$ and $26$ through $x=4$. The 22nd observation is $4$, so the median is $4$.

Calculator check: the same frequency data give $\mathrm{med}=4$.
